*Haldor's timber carts use the Saltwood Road. Walking stumps and grave-grey mushrooms have taken to standing in it.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 30 [Dark Stump](../monsters/dark_stump.md)
- Defeat 25 [Zombie Mushroom](../monsters/zombie_mushroom.md)

## Rewards

- 900 EXP
- 640 mesos
- +15 standing with Goa Harbour
- +100 standing with [Haldor](../npcs/haldor_timber.md)
